text:
Yes. **Monzo offers UK joint accounts**, and you don’t have to be a couple—you can open one with a partner, friend, relative or housemate.

### Who can apply
You’ll both need to:
- Be **18 or over** and live in the UK full time.
- Already have your own **Monzo personal accounts**.

### How to open one
In the Monzo app, go to **Home**, tap **+**, then **Apply for a joint account**. Follow the steps to invite the other person. If you don’t see the plus button, look for the joint-account option lower down on the Home screen. You may need the latest app version and to enable the relevant contact/profile settings to find or invite each other.

### How it works
- It’s a **separate account** with its own account details, so you can use it for shared bills and spending.
- You both get a debit card and can see the joint account’s transactions in the app.
- You keep your personal Monzo accounts; the other person **can’t see your personal account**.
- You both have **equal ownership and access** to the money and account features. Either of you can spend from it, so only open one with someone you trust.
- You can use Pots for shared budgets or savings goals.

Check Monzo’s current terms and fees in the app before applying, particularly for cash withdrawals, overdrafts and any paid account plans. Sources: [Monzo’s joint-account page](https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account) and [opening instructions](https://monzo.com/help/opening-an-account/how-to-open-a-Monzo-Joint-Account).
